description: The summit also saw the launch of Maharashtra Health Digital Platform (MHDP), a blockchain-based system for secure patient records and transparent procurement, projected to save the state nearly ₹2,000 crore annually.
body_lead: The Pulse 2026 conference, Maharashtra’s flagship platform on healthcare policy and digital transformation, concluded at the Jio World Convention Centre on Wednesday. The two-day summit drew more than 1,500 participants from government, industry, and academia, with a focus on AI-driven governance, telemedicine expansion, and data-led public health delivery.
